description: This PHP file defines an abstract class `CallExpression` in the Twig templating engine. The class handles compilation of callable expressions, including processing of arguments, reflection, and differentiating between various callable types. It provides methods used for compiling Twig nodes that represent function or method calls within templates.

classes.name: Twig\Node\Expression\CallExpression
classes.description: An abstract class that provides methods for compiling expression nodes representing callable objects within Twig templates, handling various callable types, argument processing, and reflection.

methods.name: compileCallable
methods.description: Compiles the callable part of the expression, handling different callable representations such as strings, arrays, extension objects, and dynamic callables, and generating the appropriate PHP code.

methods.name: compileArguments
methods.description: Compiles the arguments for the callable, including charset, environment, context, and nodes or argument nodes, into PHP code either as an array or a parenthesis-enclosed list.

methods.name: getArguments
methods.description: Deprecated method for extracting arguments, replaced by the CallableArgumentsExtractor utility.

methods.name: normalizeName
methods.description: Deprecated method for normalizing argument names to lowercase with underscores.

methods.name: getCallableParameters
methods.description: Reflects on the callable to obtain its parameters, considering special parameter shifts for environment, context, and charset, and handling variadic parameters.

methods.name: reflectCallable
methods.description: Creates and caches a ReflectionCallable object for introspecting a TwigCallableInterface.

methods.name: getTwigCallable
methods.description: Retrieves and potentially updates the TwigCallableInterface associated with this node, based on node attributes and extending support for Twig tests, functions, filters.
